source_caption:
The Age of Adaline (2015), directed by Lee Toland Krieger, is a romantic fantasy drama about a woman who mysteriously stops aging. Blake Lively plays Adaline Bowman, who, after a strange accident in the 1930s, remains the same age for decades.

Because of her secret, she’s forced to live a quiet, isolated life, constantly changing identities and avoiding close relationships so no one discovers the truth. Everything shifts when she meets Ellis, played by Michiel Huisman, a man who makes her think about what it would mean to finally stop running and live a real life.

The film mixes romance with a soft touch of fantasy, focusing on time, love, and the weight of watching life move on without you. At its core, it’s about how the fear of loss can keep someone from truly living, even when they have all the time in the world.

source_details.synopsis: The Age of Adaline is a 2015 American romantic fantasy film directed by Lee Toland Krieger and written by J. Mills Goodloe and Salvador Paskowitz. The film stars Blake Lively as Adaline, with Michiel Huisman, Harrison Ford, Kathy Baker, Amanda Crew, and Ellen Burstyn. Narrated by Hugh Ross, the story follows Adaline Bowman, a young woman who stops aging following an accident at the age of twenty-nine. The film was produced by Sidney Kimmel Entertainment and Lakeshore Entertainment. Principal photography took place in Vancouver from March 5 to May 5, 2014.
